parameters.text:
=You write one or two short sentences describing gold market conditions for a Telegram signal channel.

RULES — these are absolute:
- Write in this language: {{ $json.langName }}. Use the natural trading vocabulary of that language, as a market analyst would write it — not a literal translation.
- Write numbers with a PERIOD as the decimal separator (4357.91), never a comma. A comma decimal fails the number check downstream and your text is discarded.
- Two sentences maximum. Under 200 characters in total.
- State ONLY numbers that appear in the FACTS below. Never introduce a price, level or percentage that is not listed there.
- Never use imperative buy/sell language ("buy", "sell", "go long", "enter here"). Describe what the market is doing, not what the reader should do.
- No greeting, no preamble, no disclaimer, no emoji, no hashtags.
- Plain text only. No markdown and no HTML tags.

The FACTS are given in English (event names may already be in the target language). Read them and write your response in the language named above.

FACTS:
{{ $json.llmFacts }}

nodes.name: Write prose
nodes.notes: Prose only. Numbers are validated against llmFacts in Format; anything invented is discarded in favour of the template.

nodes.name: Anthropic Chat Model
nodes.notes: Haiku 4.5 is ample for two sentences from supplied numbers (~$1/month). If it errors with Could not get parameter "model.value", re-select the model from the dropdown to rewrite it as a resource locator.

nodes.name: Format message
nodes.notes: Reads the Scorer by node reference because the LLM chain replaces the item json.

parameters.jsCode:
/* ============================================================================
 * NODE 6/6 — Log row
 * n8n Code node · Language: JavaScript · Mode: Run Once for All Items
 * ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Runs after Send to channel, and emits ONLY the 16 columns
 * the sheet is designed to hold.
 *
 * WHY THIS NODE EXISTS: the Google Sheets node's "Map Automatically" mode does
 * not ignore input fields that have no matching header — it CREATES a column
 * for each one. Wiring Format message straight into it added six unwanted
 * columns (messageHtml, disableNotification and the four _diagnostics), putting
 * a 500-character HTML blob in every row and letting the sheet schema be
 * decided by whatever happened to be on the item.
 *
 * The schema is a design decision, not an emergent property. This node is the
 * one place that decides it.
 *
 * The diagnostics are still visible on the Format message node in the n8n UI
 * for debugging. To log one deliberately — _proseSource is the useful one, since
 * it tells you how often the LLM's prose is being rejected — add the header to
 * the sheet AND add the field to COLUMNS below. Both, in that order.
 * ==========================================================================*/

const COLUMNS = [
  'ts_utc',
  'price',
  'signal_id',
  'direction',
  'score',
  'conviction',
  'entry',
  'stop',
  'target',
  'rr',
  'components',
  'event_gate_min',
  'session',
  'consecutive',
  'notified',
  'outcome_24h',
];

// Telegram replaces the input JSON with its API response. Read the signal
// explicitly so the successful delivery is logged with the original fields.
const src = $('Format message').first().json;

const row = {};
for (const col of COLUMNS) {
  const v = src[col];
  // Blank out null/undefined so the cell is empty rather than reading "null".
  // Note `??` deliberately preserves false and 0, which are real values here
  // (notified can be false, and event_gate_min or score can legitimately be 0).
  row[col] = v ?? '';
}

return [{ json: row, pairedItem: { item: 0 } }];

nodes.name: Log row
nodes.notes: Emits only the 16 sheet columns. Google Sheets autoMap CREATES a column for any unmatched input field, so Format must not feed it directly.

nodes.name: Send to channel
nodes.notes: HTML parse mode, not MarkdownV2 — MarkdownV2 400s on any unescaped . or - and every price has both.

nodes.name: Log to Sheets
nodes.notes: Upsert by ts_utc makes write retries safe after an uncertain response. Log row supplies only the 16 header columns.
